property_summary: Calling seedMarket with any amount of drugs sets marketDrugs to exactly that amount and initializes the market, regardless of the input.
For any positive rt, calculateTrade(rt, rs, bs) never returns more than bs, i.e. a trade can never be worth more than the reserve being traded into.
For any amount, devFee returns exactly 4% (floor(amount*4/100)) and never exceeds the amount itself.
Calling buyDrugs with any Ether amount adds drugs to the caller's claim but leaves marketDrugs unchanged.
After getFreeKilo, the caller's kilos become exactly STARTING_KILOS (300).

After seeding the market, calling buyDrugs with v wei increases the caller's claimedDrugs by exactly calculateDrugBuy(v, balanceBefore - v) minus its 4% dev fee, and leaves the contract's balance increased by v minus the 4% fee on v.
After seeding the market, buying drugs with v wei increases the caller's claimedDrugs by exactly calculateDrugBuySimple(v) minus its 4% dev fee.
After seeding the market, buying drugs with v wei increases the caller's claimedDrugs by exactly calculateDrugBuySimple(v) minus the 4% dev fee, for small bounded v.
After seeding the market, a buyDrugs call with any amount of Ether leaves marketDrugs unchanged.

After getFreeKilo, a caller's pending drugs (getMyDrugs) are capped at DRUGS_TO_PRODUCE_1KILO * STARTING_KILOS regardless of elapsed time, because production accrues for at most one day's worth of seconds.
